The script never checks the client's exit status. A client that refuses (no global, ClientSide, timeout) exits nonzero, and the script then fails 'kill -0 "$client"' after sleep 100 and still prints DL10_END. SSD qualification must therefore come from the capture: DL10_SSD_CONFIGURED <nonce> mode=server_side before the first DL10_CLIENT_FRAME, no 'darwin-wayland-client-ssd:' error line, and title-bar pixels above the client block. DL10_END alone proves nothing.
